articles.title: For Some New Voters, a Ballot Carries the Whole Family
articles.summary: New citizens and young voters from immigrant families say voting feels bigger than themselves, because it also speaks for parents and relatives who cannot vote.

articles.title: How the AP Decides Who Won an Election
articles.summary: The AP collects results for nearly 7,000 races and only calls a winner when rivals have no path left; a new Voter Poll surveys early and Election Day voters.

articles.title: Judge Says California Must Keep Counting Ballots as They Are
articles.summary: A federal judge rejected a request to separate up to 20,000 California ballots, saying it would disrupt an election already underway; the Justice Department said it will appeal.
